name: Shinai Dojo
description: Shinai Dojo — a neighbourhood kendo dojo theme set like a magazine. A formal top header carries the dojo name and tagline, a Book a trial class button and a menu button that opens a full-screen madder red overlay with large numbered entries. Akane (#B7282E), the deep madder red of traditional Japanese dyeing, is the main colour: the cover, the dojo band and every page head are madder fields with a faint asanoha hemp-leaf pattern texture multiplied in, set in plaster white with hinoki-gold labels. The cover is a stacked collage: the issue line, title, lead, buttons and the contents of this issue on the left, three numbered 2.5D isometric plates of the dojo stacked and offset on the right, and a cut-out kendo helmet (transparent WebP) breaking out of the stack and over the cover bottom edge; a cut-out dojo drum breaks over the top edge of the dojo band and the bottom edge of every page head. The home page reads as three features: the classes as a magazine spread with a drop cap and a pull quote, the dojo story with the founding year in giant type, and a practice in four plates on pale madder with the light pattern; a synced practice board and the fees are kept in one place each. Every picture is a 2.5D isometric illustration. Shippori Antique for display, Libre Franklin for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-11 (editorial-magazine, stacked-collage hero, overlay nav, pattern-texture, 2.5d-isometric, akane #B7282E, Shippori Antique + Libre Franklin, kendo dojo in education-classes). A formal top header with the dojo name, the Book a trial class button and the overlay menu button. Pattern texture: an asanoha hemp-leaf tile multiplied into every madder field and a light version on the pale madder practice band. Break-frame: the cut-out kendo helmet breaks out of the stacked plates and over the cover bottom edge, and the cut-out dojo drum over the dojo band and page heads.

summary.zh-TW: 茜紅色的社區劍道道場：雜誌式版面、疊放拼貼主視覺、全螢幕選單、麻葉紋理、去背護面破格而出、2.5D 等角插畫，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A madder red kendo dojo set like a magazine: a stacked-collage cover, overlay menu, asanoha texture, cut-out helmet and isometric plates.
summary.ja: 茜色の町の剣道場。雑誌のような誌面、重ねたコラージュの表紙、全画面メニュー、麻の葉の地紋、枠を越える面の切り抜き、等角イラスト。
summary.fr: Un dojo de kendo rouge garance mis en page comme un magazine : couverture en collage, menu plein écran, motif asanoha, casque détouré.
summary.de: Ein krapprotes Kendo-Dojo im Magazin-Stil: Collage-Titel, Vollbild-Menü, Asanoha-Muster, freigestellter Helm, isometrische Bilder.
